3mgb-wilderness-radio.alt: The corner of the Croajingolong Centre for Communications and the Arts, its name lettered on the timber wall beside the woven circular sculpture, with the 3MGB studio window around the corner.

ambulance-victoria.alt: Two ambulances parked at the Mallacoota branch, one under an open carport and one on the apron beside the brick station with its Ambulance Victoria sign and roller door.

ampol-mallacoota.alt: The Caltex-signed service station with its red canopy and price board, palms along the grass verge.

ampol-mallacoota-2.alt: The Caltex forecourt seen past palm trees, the shop signed Caltex Mallacoota behind the pumps.

beachcomber-caravan-park.alt: The entrance drive into Beachcomber Caravan Park under gum trees, past orange signs for units and cabins, tent and van sites, a heated pool and a BBQ area.

beanie-coffee-van.alt: Tables, chairs and green umbrellas on the grass around the Beanie coffee van under a large gum tree, with people sitting in the sun.

beanie-coffee-van-2.alt: The serving hatch of the Beanie coffee van, a converted horse float, with cups stacked on the timber counter and chairs set out on the grass.

bega-valley-garage-doos.alt: The Bega Valley Garage Doors logo: a blue roller door beside green rolling hills.

bp-mallacoota.alt: The BP service station under its green canopy, the kiosk signed Fishing and Camping, Bait and Tackle, with a bait sign on the corner.

bp-mallacoota-2.alt: The BP forecourt from across the road, pumps under the green canopy with the fuel price board, and Mallacoota Automotive and Towing next door.

cafe-54.alt: The Cafe 54 corner on Maurice Avenue, with street-side tables in its branded barriers and the pharmacy and Foodworks beyond.

cafe-54-2.alt: Cafe 54 from along the footpath, its timber gable sign above the open frontage and blackboard menus beside the door.

colin-dixon.alt: A coloured-pencil style portrait of Colin Dixon, smiling in a patterned shirt with sunglasses pushed up on his head, outside a brick house.

community-bank-mallacoota.alt: The Community Bank Mallacoota branch on the corner, signed Bendigo Bank with an ATM, its ramp leading to the door.

gabo-views.alt: The Gabo Views holiday cottage behind its grey picket fence, a sign on the fence showing the lighthouse, with chairs on the deck.

harbour-lights-holiday-flats-2.alt: The entrance to Harbour Lights from Betka Road, the drive running in past a lawn, camellias and a green fence.

iga-local-grocer-mallacoota-2.alt: The brick corner of the IGA Local Grocer building, with the Home Timber and Hardware mural along the side wall.

lees-pizza-take-away.alt: Lee's Pizza and Take Away under its curved verandah, with Chinese Take Away, burgers and fish and chips lettered on the windows.

lucys-chinese-restaurant.alt: Lucy's Chinese Restaurant behind its red and white striped awnings, with timber benches either side of the door.

mallacoota-cemetery-3.alt: Rows of graves across the cemetery lawn, polished granite and pale headstones under tall eucalypts against a clear sky.

mallacoota-foodworks-3.alt: Foodworks with its open flag out, benches and a bin enclosure on the footpath and the pharmacy next door.

A newer grey building at the community precinct, with the inlet and far hills behind it.
The playground at the community precinct under its shade sails, with a slide, climbing frame and a picnic shelter alongside.
The skate park across the lawn, with riders on the bowl and a bench under the trees.
The skate park close up, its ramps and shade shelter beside picnic tables under a large gum.

mallacoota-meats.alt: The butcher's shopfront beneath its Try a Little Tenderness sign, with community notices in the window.

mallacoota-visitor-information-3.alt: The Mallacoota Service Centre from the road, its teal panelling and ramp beside the visitor centre.

mallacoota-youth-and-sports-club-3.alt: The club pavilion beside the oval, its verandah looking out over the grass to the light towers.

mallacoota-youth-and-sports-club-tennis.alt: The tennis courts behind their wire fence, with a Mallacoota Youth and Sports Club banner and a note advertising social tennis on Sundays.

morning-melodies.alt: People gathered at long tables in a room hung with historic photographs, with a guitarist, an accordionist and a drummer playing at the far end.

south-eastern-home-hardware-yard.alt: The Home Timber and Hardware yard entrance, its teal painted wall lettered with the Home logo and stock stacked along the drive.

st-peters-mallacoota-2.alt: The church and hall on their lawn above the inlet, cars parked alongside and the water and far hills beyond.

st-peters-op-shop.alt: The parish op shop behind the church, its door open under the verandah with racks of clothing outside and an open sign by the entrance.

st-peters-op-shop-2.alt: The sign for the Parish of Croajingolong St Peters Op Shop on the weatherboard wall, listing weekday and Saturday opening hours.

sundayss.alt: The Sundayss shopfront on the walkway, with a thatched awning and a surfboard sign above the door.

the-wilderness-collective.alt: The Wilderness Collective shopfront, its windows lettered Learn with us, Build with us, Work with us, with a table and chairs outside.

victoria-state-emergency-service-2.alt: The SES depot from the lawn, flagpoles in front of the low blue-doored building with its vehicle bays along the sealed apron.
